notes.title: Demo version is live
notes.content:
[b][h1]Join our discord[/h1][/b]
[h2]Join the discord to know all about the game and become a game tester.[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/3cQP76cSvn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764064/0f30fe22db60b87464b3761a2f6954033ee7a362.png[/img][/url]
[b][h1]About the demo[/h1]
[/b]The demo will show you how the game will be. It's single-player now, but in the future will be online co-op horror.
[b][h1]When The Full Game Will Release? [/h1][/b]
For now I don't know when the full game will finish, because the game will take more than two month to finish the beta version. 

[h3]At the end I want to thank you guys for supporting my game, I've received a very motivated messages and i'm happy with that.
[/h3]
Thank you for reading this announcement.
